title: Fourier basis for a product group
statement: For every positive integer $m$ and natural number $n$, the complex-valued functions on $( Z/m Z)^n$ have a basis indexed by the elements of $( Z/m Z)^n$, obtained by indexing the abelian Fourier basis using the product-group character equivalence.
